correctness.rationale: The Artin–Schreier extension is separable of degree 3 and has exactly m simple poles. Its different exponents give genus 2m−2; Deuring–Shafarevich gives p-rank 2m−2. Distinct index-3 rational subfields would produce a birational curve of bidegree (3,3), forcing genus at most 4, contradicting g>=8; hence the x-rational subfield is characteristic under all automorphisms. A binary Hessian of U^m−V^m has nonzero coefficient and zero set precisely {0,infinity}, forcing branch-set stabilizer to have exactly 2m elements. Every automorphism lies above this group with deck kernel C3, yielding upper bound 6m. The explicit reflection S lifts (using c^3−c=−lambda), commutes/inverts as claimed and with rotation and translation realizes the full order 6m. Finite exact checks at m=5,8,11,14 corroborate Hessian and group identities, not the infinite implication.

value.rationale: Determining the full automorphism group of the explicit genus-eight curve left at the level of an order-15 cyclic action is a natural missing invariant: it distinguishes a true dihedral extension from potentially larger wild automorphism groups. The proof gives a complete all-parameter family classification for infinitely many genera and identifies a meaningful positive-characteristic rigidity mechanism through uniqueness of trigonal pencils and binary Hessians. This is geometric structure of a naturally motivated family, not a parameter substitution or generic genus formula; it may support quotient geometry and automorphism strata without requiring downstream theorems.
